score_breakdown.note: The overall score rewards the exact, claim-disciplined negative screen but does not waive either next-gate P0.

m222_exact_screen.admission: The exact M51-s10 decoding, receptive-field work, fixed source-key-mod-K grouping, product conservation, and stated ideal cycle arithmetic are reproducible.

m222_next_gate.required_pivot: Use a 96-lane add-only K1 sparse reference for any matched sparse comparison and pivot the performance line to FC1 because no legal 8x128-bit patch point crosses 1.5x.

geometry_and_mapping_checks.bitpack_decode: SHA-checked uint8 payload, LITTLE_WITHIN_BYTE unpack, C-order reshape, and manifest active-count check passed for all 60 records.
geometry_and_mapping_checks.conv_geometry: The selected topology is six Conv2d layers with 3x3, padding 1, output channels 96; module 0 and module 5 are stride 2 and modules 1-4 are stride 1. All manifest input/output shapes satisfy the convolution output equation.
geometry_and_mapping_checks.flattened_source_key: PyTorch Conv2d weight order [out,in,ky,kx] gives source_key=((in*3+ky)*3+kx)=9*in+tap; direct recomputation used source_key mod K separately for K=1,2,4,8 rather than folding the M222 occ8 tensor.
geometry_and_mapping_checks.group_optimality_under_contract: For a fixed output token and destination slice, max per-bank occupancy is the minimum number of groups when each bank may issue at most one source row and arbitrary commutative rows from different banks may coissue.
geometry_and_mapping_checks.product_conservation: Every model point preserves 1774268587*96=170329784352 source-destination updates; no additional zero, delta, weight row, or byte skip is present.

k1_d96.reason: One active binary source contribution uses one signed INT8 weight-add into each of 96 destinations in one cycle. It does not serialize the six 16-destination weight slices.

k4_d32.reason: It spends 1.333x add lanes and issue bits for only 1.105x serial speedup; it does not cross the 1.5x contract gate.

k8_d16_m218_like.reason: The 5.659x bank-group reduction is smaller than the six destination slices, so service grows to 1881194940 cycles versus K1's 1774268587 despite 1.333x lanes.

k8_d32.reason: The point needs 2048 weight bits/cycle and 256 add lanes, equivalent to 16x128-bit reads. Relative to K1's used 768 bits and 96 lanes this is 2.667x issue bandwidth and lanes for 1.794x serial speedup.

profile_sensitivity.qualification: All ten clips are from zurich_city_09_a; these are stable within-sequence M51-s10 ratios applied to a profile100 ledger, not a measured profile100 or cross-sequence speedup.

findings.title: A 96-INT8-MAC matched reference is unfair against an add-only candidate on exact-binary sparse inputs
findings.evidence: All six selected inputs are exact binary and M222 services only active source contributions. K1 therefore also replaces activation multiplication with a gated signed INT8 weight-add. Giving K1 96 MACs while giving KxD only adders prices an optimization already owned by both sparse designs.
findings.required_action: Use 96 add-only K1 versus KxD add-only for the sparse matched comparison. A dense 96-MAC design may be retained only as a separately labelled conventional dense baseline.

findings.title: No point legal under the frozen 8x128-bit issue contract exceeds the 1.5x advance gate
findings.evidence: K4D32 is the best legal point at 1.104921x serial; K8D16 is 0.946285x. K8D32 reaches 1.793944x only with 16 equivalent 128-bit bank reads and 256 lanes.
findings.required_action: Do not advance K8D32 as an 8-bank patch result. Treat it only as a resource-scaled sensitivity with normalized PPA/energy, or follow the existing contract and pivot to FC1.

findings.title: The K1 row-striped equal-capacity SRAM layout and routing are not closed
findings.evidence: A fixed six-bank row stripe leaves two banks unused and requires 4/3 more depth in each used bank than an evenly distributed eight-bank store. Rotating each row across six of eight banks restores equal aggregate capacity but adds a six-of-eight selector and lane permutation.
findings.required_action: Specify rotating/equal-capacity row placement, bank depth, read address, and bank-to-destination routing before any macro or area comparison.

findings.title: Accumulator width, K-way combine trees, ports, and 96-channel commit bandwidth are idealized
findings.evidence: The premodel counts products but does not choose an accumulator width or price K-source reduction and accumulator RMW. One output token/cycle also implies an internal 96-value transfer, wider than eight 128-bit banks for any accumulator above 10 bits.
findings.required_action: Close fixed-point range, lane/tree structure, local accumulator residency, spill behavior, and commit interface.

findings.title: Line-buffer storage and the scan/service backpressure schedule are absent
findings.evidence: The 69.12M scan cycles assume one complete 48/96-channel input vector per cycle, while service is much slower. Serial counting is arithmetically conservative but does not prove that a bounded two/three-row buffer, occupancy metadata, and output-token accumulator can realize the ordering without full-frame storage.
findings.required_action: Provide a bounded streaming schedule with row lifetime, stalls, metadata depth, and source fanout realization.

findings.title: Current-batch dynamic BN is outside the patch cycle path
findings.evidence: The H67 patch topology places BN/SpikingNorm around the convolutions. M162 reports no_running AEE 1.309925 versus running AEE 1.469151, so static running-stat folding is not accuracy-admitted. M222 explicitly excludes the moment barrier and replay/materialization cost.
findings.required_action: Add current-batch moment, barrier, normalization/replay, and activation/residual costs, or first close a running-stat recalibration result that permits static folding.

findings.title: Profile sensitivity is within one DSEC sequence and is not profile100 execution
findings.evidence: The ten M51 clips are all from zurich_city_09_a. Their ratios are stable, but scaling the frozen profile100 ledger does not establish cross-sequence cycles.
findings.required_action: If patch remains in scope, extend exact traces across sequences/event-density strata and run the selected cycle model directly.

findings.title: There is no matched RTL, VCS calibration, DC, SRAM macro, or energy evidence
findings.evidence: M222 correctly marks all these boundaries false. Wider points change peak word width, adder count, routing, tree depth, and bank peripheral energy.
findings.required_action: Only after a fair legal point survives should matched RTL/DC and macro-aware energy be run.
